status: draft: proposal docs/jev-implementation.md 8.3 and 8.4, not accepted
description: Every threshold that turns a Jev answer into a decision, and the parameters of the state builder. Start values are the doc's [ASSUMPTION] values; change them only with a measurement attached to the pull request (doc 12.3).

gates._comment: De-escalation gates of doc 8.3. All must pass for auto_close_fp. G1 = mode gated; G2 = rule listed in auto_close_rules (and not in never_auto_rules) with level below max_auto_close_level. G4 also needs a benign pattern verified in code (codeCtx.benign_pattern_verified = yes), whatever Jev answers to benign_pattern_match. G12 (added to the doc's list) = no fact has a value in blocked_fact_classes.

escalation._comment: Triggers of doc 8.4. Severity scales: Jev 0 negligible, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high; TheHive 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 critical. The severity trigger fires when Jev's expected value >= severity_ev_min and the TheHive severity is below severity_thehive_below.

state._comment: State builder parameters (doc 6.2). soc_internal lists the SOC's own ranges and is empty here: no address is hardcoded in the repo, the playbook supplies them at run time (README, integrator changes). An address is classified in this order: soc_internal, documentation, private, else public.
